tools.name: search_courses
tools.description: Search public golf courses (currently NYC metro) with official tee-time booking links. Filters are optional. Courses with unknown fee/location are excluded only when that filter is set. Does not check live tee-time availability; `date` is echoed back with booking-window notes.

tools.name: get_course
tools.description: Full record for one course by slug (fees, caveats, resident rules, sources).

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Official booking deep link and method (online/phone) for a course. Send the user here to book.
